async function run(items, read) {
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (const item of items) await read(item);
 for (const item of items)
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await read(item);
 // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
 for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) await read(items[i]);
 for (const item of await load()) print(item);
}
